|game1= arma2
|version1= 1.00

|game2= arma2oa

|game4= arma3
|version4= 0.50

|arg= local

|eff= local

|gr1= Mission Information

|descr= Finish the mission.
'''Mission saves are deleted'''. Use [[failMission]] if they should not be.
{{Feature|arma3|To maintain {{arma3}} visual style, it is recommended to use [[BIS_fnc_endMission]] instead.}}

|mp= To end mission properly so that everyone goes to debriefing at the same time, this command should be executed on every machine (see {{Link|#Example 2}}).

|s1= [[endMission]] endType

|p1= endType: [[String]] - can be a custom one {{GVI|arma3|1.00|size= 0.75}}, or one of:
{{Columns|2|
* "CONTINUE" (does nothing)
* "KILLED"
* "LOSER"
* "END1"
* "END2"
* "END3"
* "END4"
* "END5"
* "END6"
}}

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>endMission "END1";</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>["END1"] remoteExec ["endMission", 0, true]; // Arma 3</sqf>

|seealso= [[missionEnd]] [[failMission]] [[forceEnd]]
}}
